_comment: A municipal indoor pool is the loudest quiet place in the menu: constant water movement, constant reflected light on the ceiling, and absolutely nothing happening. It gives the animate stage the most to work with of any preset here.
label: The swimming pool

prompt._comment: Condensation on the high windows is doing two jobs -- it dates the building and it explains why the daylight is diffuse. Do not trade it for a cleaner description.
prompt.scene: a municipal indoor swimming pool, pale blue tiles, lane ropes across the water, a high ceiling of ribbed panels, a lifeguard chair at the side, condensation on the high windows
prompt.light: diffuse daylight through the misted windows plus rows of fluorescent fittings overhead, reflections off the water crawling across the ceiling
prompt.lens: wide down the length of the pool, everything a little flattened, the far end losing its edges
prompt.framing: waist-up at the tiled edge, the lanes running away behind
prompt._moment: What is HAPPENING, not what is in frame. A brief with no action in it is a portrait brief, and the model answers it with a portrait -- squared to the camera, arms hanging, waiting. Somebody caught halfway through something ordinary is what a real snapshot looks like.
prompt.moment: just up out of the water at the tiled edge, one hand still on the rail and water running off
prompt.eraProps: a stopwatch on a lanyard, a plastic locker key on a wrist band, a scratched vending machine, a tiled mosaic on the far wall

motionHint: the water surface never stops moving and its reflections travel slowly across the ceiling and the tiles

lookOverride._comment: Every hard highlight on moving water is a halation source, so this is the one preset that opens bloom furthest. Saturation stays fairly high because the tiles carry the only real colour in the frame.

ambience._comment: A tiled hall. The echo IS the room -- every hard surface, nothing soft anywhere -- and the swell is the water surface the preset already describes as never stopping.
